selection_rule: all primary assignments other than well_textured
priority_rule: C001, manual textureless labels, remaining candidates
fm_rule: up to five deterministic projected-footprint views and ten ranked view pairs per building; MASt3R reciprocal 2D matches only; crop coordinates inverted to raw FULL_OPENCV pixels; undistort; float64 fixed COLMAP-pose DLT; positive depths; distorted source-pixel reprojection <=2px; pool all completed nondegenerate pairs before footprint-inside z median and count
view_rule: top five by outline in-frame fraction, outline valid pixels, zenith, image name
pair_rule: up to ten unordered pairs ranked by minimum in-frame fraction, minimum outline pixels, 3D camera baseline, maximum zenith, names
